# testing_name_shadowing (Data Source)

NameShadowing DataSource

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "testing_name_shadowing" "my_nameshadowing" {
  id = "...my_id..."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `big` (String) Shadows the math/big package from z_requires_big_import.
- `container_object_for_json_array` (Attributes) Container object for additional test cases of name shadowing. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--container_object_for_json_array))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `json` (String) Shadows the encoding/json package from z_requires_json_import.
- `operations` (Attributes) Tests SDK package name (operations) as an object type to verify symbol naming does not collide with SDK imports. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--operations))
- `time` (String) Shadows the time package from z_requires_time_import.
- `types` (String) Shadows the SDK types package from z_requires_sdk_types_import.
- `z_requires_big_import` (Number)
- `z_requires_json_import` (String) Parsed as JSON.
- `z_requires_sdk_types_import` (String)
- `z_requires_time_import` (String)
